privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This website is a free guide to the historic sites of Madinah. You do not need to sign in, and we do not collect personal data about visitors.
privacy.collectBody: Only aggregated usage statistics, which do not identify you personally:
collectItems: The number of visits and how many times each page is opened
Your country or approximate city, worked out from the network, not from your exact location
The link that brought you to us
Questions sent to the “AI Guide” and its answers — their text is stored without a name, IP address or location, to improve the quality of the answers and measure their accuracy
Your quiz results from before and after a journey, and your rating of the journey — only if you tap “Send result”, and without any personal data

Your opinion of a journey and your name if you type it (optional) — sent only if you agree to its publication, published only after review, and shown with your name as typed or as “Visitor”. To have it removed, email us at the address below.
privacy.neverBody: We do not ask for or store any of the following about visitors to the site:
neverItems: Name, email address or phone number
Your exact location on the map
Any data to be sold or shared for advertising
toolsItems: Google Analytics — to measure the number of visitors and the most visited pages. It places a cookie in your browser, so we ask you first: it runs only after you agree, and it does not store the full IP address.
Vercel Analytics — a visit counter that uses no cookies and does not identify anyone, so it always runs and does not need your consent.

Google Gemini — writes the “AI Guide” answers from the approved sources. Only the text of your question is sent to it. On the free plan, Google may use the questions to improve its services, so do not write any personal information in your question.
privacy.locationBody: The “Nearest places to you” feature asks for location permission only when you tap the button, and distances are calculated on your device. If you tap “Share my location” in the AI Guide, an approximate location (accurate to about 100 meters) is sent with your question to calculate distances, and it is not stored. “My Journey” and your progress in journeys stay only on your device.
privacy.hostingBody: The site is hosted on Vercel, and images and video are served through Cloudflare. Like any web server, these two services log IP addresses temporarily, for operation and security only, and we do not link these logs to any person.
privacy.controlBody: You can change your choice here at any time, and the change takes effect immediately.
privacy.statusOnHint: Thank you — this helps us learn which places visitors are looking for.
privacy.statusOffHint: Google Analytics is not loaded, and no cookie is placed in your browser.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about privacy, or to ask us to delete data, email us at
